ohp.criteria: Standing strict barbell press: planted feet, stable trunk, shoulder-width-plus grip, bar clears face and moves overhead as arms extend. Controlled return. Rack entry omitted.

seated-cable-row.criteria: Seated narrow neutral-grip cable row with bent knees and feet supported on inclined plates. Stable upright trunk, handle pulled toward abdomen, one-second squeeze and controlled return.

dips.criteria: Bodyweight parallel-bar dip: fixed neutral grips, slight forward torso inclination, bent knees and suspended feet. Controlled lowering to approximately right-angle elbows, then extend arms. Mounting and dismounting omitted.

limits: Procedural educational demonstration, not captured human motion or biomechanical certification.
Simplified body, garments and equipment; sampled grip/pose checks do not certify all mesh collisions. Actual phone and production not verified.
